definitions.explanation: The point or area where two lines, edges, or surfaces meet.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}の{角|すみ}に{置|お}く。
examples.english: To put it in the corner of the room.

examples.japanese: {角|すみ}から{角|すみ}まで{探|さが}した。
examples.english: I searched from corner to corner.

notes:
{角|すみ} means corner.

NOTE ON READINGS:
- {角|すみ}: corner (of room, page)
- {角|かど}: corner (of street, building), angle
- {角|つの}: horn (of animal)

EXPRESSIONS:
- {隅|すみ}に{置|お}けない: not to be taken lightly
- {隅々|すみずみ}: every corner
